caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with ornate detailing and a green flat top. The cabinet has an upper section with a single wide drawer beneath the green surface. Below the drawer, there are two doors; the left door is open, revealing two interior shelves painted in a light cream color. The cabinet features reddish-brown woodgrain panels with darker patterns, and the side and back panels exhibit a similar color and texture. The legs and column supports of the cabinet are green, with turned details, and each leg terminates in a rounded foot. There are decorative scroll-like accents at the top back corners, and the upper part of the back rises higher than the sides, with a central curved and carved design. The overall composition is centered on a plain background, bordered by a thin black line, and the artist’s signature, “Florence Truelson,” appears in the lower left corner.
title: Colonial Wash Stand
